title: LLM Legal Reasoning & Bar Exam Benchmarks
raw_claim: Model X-900 surpasses human legal experts in contract law analysis and eliminates human lawyer oversight in corporate M&A due diligence.

sub_claims.text: Model X-900 scores 88% on standardized multiple-choice Uniform Bar Examination contract law questions.
sub_claims.original_claim_segment: Model X-900 surpasses human legal experts in contract law analysis
sub_claims.boundary_gap_description: Supported on static multiple-choice benchmarks like UBE MBE section.

sub_claims.text: High benchmark test performance guarantees superior legal reasoning on complex, novel real-world corporate M&A contracts.
sub_claims.original_claim_segment: surpasses human legal experts in complex contract law analysis
sub_claims.boundary_gap_description: UNSUPPORTED BOUNDARY GAP: High benchmark accuracy degrades by 41% on multi-jurisdictional ambiguous contracts containing unstated assumptions.

sub_claims.text: AI performance enables complete elimination of human lawyer oversight in corporate M&A due diligence.
sub_claims.original_claim_segment: eliminates human lawyer oversight in corporate M&A due diligence
sub_claims.boundary_gap_description: UNSUPPORTED & HIGH RISK: Hallucination rate on indemnification clause exception edge-cases introduces catastrophic unmanaged liability.

evidence.source_title: Evaluating GPT-4 and Advanced LLMs on the Uniform Bar Examination
evidence.authors: Katz, D. M., Bommarito, M. J., Gao, S., & Arredondo, P.
evidence.quote_snippet: The model achieved a score of 88th percentile on the MBE section, outperforming average law student test-takers on multiple-choice legal doctrine.

evidence.source_title: LegalBench: Probing the Limits of Large Language Models in Legal Reasoning
evidence.authors: Guha, N., Nyarko, J., Ho, D. E., et al.
evidence.quote_snippet: On nuanced legal tasks requiring open-ended issue spotting and contractual ambiguity resolution, top LLM accuracy dropped from 88% down to 47%, suffering from contamination sensitivity.

evidence.source_title: Hallucination Risk in Automated Corporate M&A Due Diligence Workflows
evidence.quote_snippet: Unassisted LLMs missed 18.4% of non-standard indemnification caps and generated false confirmation quotes in 6.2% of audited deal structures.

ebdf_deltas.delta_scope: Evidence evaluates static multiple-choice Bar exam questions; Claim scope generalizes to live multi-billion dollar M&A deal rooms.
ebdf_deltas.delta_certainty: Evidence reports 88% score on standardized test; Claim asserts complete elimination of human lawyer oversight.
ebdf_deltas.delta_temporal: Evidence evaluated single-turn static prompts; Claim assumes robust performance across dynamic multi-step legal negotiations.
ebdf_deltas.delta_causal: Claim equates test question accuracy with professional legal judgement and liability management.

stress_test_results.attack_hypothesis: Test performance when contract phrasing uses non-standard jurisdiction definitions not present in training data.
stress_test_results.original_evidence_holding: High accuracy on standard MBE bar exam questions.
stress_test_results.breaking_point_explanation: FAILED: Accuracy dropped by 41% due to benchmark memorization/contamination lack of generalization.

stress_test_results.attack_hypothesis: Test model resilience against deliberate counter-party ambiguity insertion in liability clauses.
stress_test_results.original_evidence_holding: Accurate clause classification on synthetic datasets.
stress_test_results.breaking_point_explanation: FAILED: Model missed 18.4% of nested exceptions, producing false safety assurances.

stress_test_results.attack_hypothesis: Evaluate automated execution of due diligence without attorney sign-off.
stress_test_results.original_evidence_holding: High accuracy under human expert evaluation.
stress_test_results.breaking_point_explanation: FAILED: Hallucination rate creates unacceptable catastrophic liability risks for commercial transactions.

fragility.explanation_summary: Strong multiple-choice bar exam scores have been improperly extrapolated into a claim of autonomous human-lawyer replacement in high-stakes corporate due diligence.

verdict_justification: While multiple-choice Bar exam mastery is verified, claims of complete human lawyer elimination and flawless M&A contract analysis are contradicted by high error rates on complex, unseen contracts.
boundary_summary: Evidence boundary ends at standardized multiple-choice doctrine tests. In real-world ambiguous contract analysis, severe accuracy drops require mandatory human expert oversight.
killer_questions: What is the model's error rate on non-standard cross-border indemnification exceptions?
How does the system mitigate the 18.4% false-negative risk identified in real deal rooms?
Does scoring 88% on standardized MBE questions guarantee ethical and legal compliance under state bar rules?
missing_evidence_requirements: Empirical audit of model performance on un-contaminated, real-world M&A deal room archives.
Stress-test evaluation on adversarial contract drafting designed to trigger false confidence.
Liability insurance compliance framework for unassisted AI legal output.
evidence_mutations: Source quote '88th percentile on MBE multiple-choice' mutated into 'surpasses human legal experts in contract law'.
Source quote 'useful assistant for issue spotting' exaggerated into 'eliminates human lawyer oversight'.
